description:
A Java distributed server framework based on Aeron and Netty, featuring lock-free asynchronous and event-driven
        architecture design.
        For Java distributed network communication with nanosecond end-to-end latency, ionet is the choice.

        基于 Aeron、Netty 的 java 分布式服务器框架，无锁异步化、事件驱动架构设计。
        java 分布式网络通信，纳秒级端到端延迟就选 ionet。
